summary: Rows are divided among available GPUs per rank, with each partition receiving its rows, offsets, nonzeros and vector. Runtime row-length selection chooses Width 1/2/4/8/16/32. Each GPU captures a bounded graph of complete launches; the timed OpenMP worker distributes GPU partitions across threads, replays iterations/batch graphs plus residual launches for each nonempty partition, and synchronizes its stream. The outlined worker's graph quotient and remainder paths are bounded by iterations. Each selectable final-sm86 kernel covers its row groups and complete CSR ranges, reduces and stores.
